subject: Lighthouse roadmap realignment — can we pause the hands-on demo?
messages:
From: Alex Novak <alex.novak@lighthouse.ai>
To: tessa.morgan@redwood.com
Cc: priya@lighthouse.ai
Date: Tue, 15 Jun 2026 16:02:00 -0700
Subject: Reprioritizing our LLM pilot timeline

Hi Tessa,

Thanks again for the walkthrough last week — the team appreciated the practical performance numbers and the quantization options. After an internal roadmap discussion this morning, we need to shift some engineering resources away from our LLM/semantic search effort toward a merchant checkout initiative that has become time-sensitive.

That means we need to pause any hands-on demos and block out work on pilots for the near term. Can we put our mutual-action plan on hold for now? I attached the MVP-roadmap PDF so you can see the tradeoffs we discussed.

We still like Redwood and want to keep the conversation alive; would prefer to revisit in Q4 once the checkout work ships. If you need anything in the meantime (security checklist, perf numbers for procurement), Priya is still the internal point of contact.

Apologies for the churn — we know timing is never ideal.

Best,
Alex Novak
Head of Product
Lighthouse.ai
(Attached: MVP-roadmap.pdf)

From: tessa.morgan@redwood.com <tessa.morgan@redwood.com>
To: Alex Novak <alex.novak@lighthouse.ai>
Cc: ben.carter@redwood.com, marissa.cole@redwood.com
Date: Wed, 16 Jun 2026 09:05:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Reprioritizing our LLM pilot timeline

Alex —

Totally understand, and thanks for the heads-up and the roadmap PDF. Resource redirects happen. We'll mark the pilot as paused on our side and remove active demo invites.

A few quick asks so we keep the account warm without spamming you:
- Would you like us to hold any of the demos (recording or sandbox access) available to your team so folks can self-serve while engineering is focused on checkout?
- Can we check back in 10–12 weeks to see if Q4 planning is opening? We can pencil an internal reminder but won’t rebook calendars until you confirm.
- Want us to share a short one-pager summarizing the tradeoffs (latency vs. cost with quantization) that you can use in the product prioritization thread?

Also copying Ben and Marissa so they see the status. If you want any security artifacts for procurement now (SOC2 evidence, retention controls) we can drop those to Priya.

Best regards,
Tessa Morgan
Account Executive — Redwood Inference
redwood.com

--
Tessa Morgan
Account Executive | Redwood Inference
Mobile: +1 (415) 555-0124

From: Priya Shah <priya@lighthouse.ai>
To: tessa.morgan@redwood.com, Alex Novak <alex.novak@lighthouse.ai>
Date: Sun, 20 Jun 2026 11:22:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Reprioritizing our LLM pilot timeline

Hi Tessa —

Thanks for the quick response. We'd appreciate a lightweight one-pager and the SOC2 artifacts (if those are quick). For now, we'll ask teams to self-serve via the demo recording you mentioned; no scheduled hands-on sessions.

Confirming we prefer a 10–12 week check-in; could you try for mid-September to touch base? We'll update you sooner if priorities change.

Thanks,
Priya
Product Ops Manager
Lighthouse.ai

From: marissa.cole@redwood.com <marissa.cole@redwood.com>
To: tessa.morgan@redwood.com, ben.carter@redwood.com
Date: Mon, 21 Jun 2026 15:30:00 -0700
Subject: Fwd: Reprioritizing our LLM pilot timeline

Tessa / Ben —

Looping in to confirm: agree with pausing active scheduling. Ben, please archive the MAP (mutual-action-plan.xlsx) in the Lighthouse account folder and set a task to follow up 10 weeks from today. No credits or exceptions needed unless the prospect asks — they aren't canceling procurement, just shifting timing.

Ben, a couple of optional actions if you want to keep engagement warm: share a 2-slide ROI snippet and a short demo recording (no live setup) — both low effort and useful for product teams during reprioritization. Tessa, Ben, feel free to coordinate directly with Alex/Priya.

Marissa Cole
Sales Manager | Redwood Inference
(Attached: mutual-action-plan.xlsx)
